body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Civitavecchia, Italy. It starts at Largo della Pace.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Go on a historical tour from Civitavecchia port with three departure times. Begin the journey from the Barriera San Giusto.
>
> Reach the medieval city center and stroll through the narrow streets while exploring the churches, walls, and historic buildings, all known for their amazing views.
>
> Continue walking for 20 minutes to explore the unique underground Etruscan Archaeological Park. Watch the artistry of Omero, known as the "last of the Etruscans,” and observe the recreated artifacts, tombs, homes, and scenes of daily life.
